_meta.note: Re-audit of the S278 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash sources. Missed: the Section 5.3.3 effort-25 endpoints (DeepSWE 66.0, TB2.1 82.4, 8-bench reasoning average 67.1->76.3). Everything else re-checked with nothing further: HF repo evaluation/ holds only reproduction instructions and a patch; assets/ has the two charts already read; config.json exposes only model_type; Section 4.2.1 is architecture hyper-parameters (40 layers, d=5120, 384+1 experts, 6 active, top-k 512, ViT 32 layers) - metadata, not scores; Sections 5.1/5.2 give no evaluable counts; OpenRouter per-provider throughput/latency (DeepSeek 142 tps / 1.37 s) is volatile and not ingested by policy; the pricing page's V4 Pro retirement date was already recorded in S278 notes.
